init_fb_h36m_dataset: init a Facebook Human3.6M dataset from a path and compute 3D positions for all subjects and actions
pose3D_from_fb_h36m: extract 3D pose sequences from a Human3.6M dataset subject and action with camera-to-world transformation
rot_seq_to_deepmimic_json: write a rotation sequence numpy array to a DeepMimic JSON file with loop flag and frame data
review_joint_info: review the joint_info dictionary that defines 17 human joints with parent indices and left-right side labels
summarize_deepmimic_json_generator: summarize the deepmimic_json_generator module that loads Human3.6M mocap data, extracts 3D poses, and exports DeepMimic JSON
